moments.title: She wrote about wealth creation for years without knowing how to manage her own money
moments.summary: The speaker — who later in the clip says she started Investing for Mummies — recounts spending years writing about wealth creation while not knowing how to manage her own money, and concluding you do not need to love spreadsheets or be great with numbers.
moments.evidence: So in the last video I shared about how I spent years writing about wealth creation but I didn't know how to manage my own money myself.
search_terms: you don't need to be a finance expert

moments.title: So many women want to understand money but feel overwhelmed
moments.summary: She says she realised she was not alone: many women want to understand money but are put off by how complicated finance appears.
moments.evidence: So many women want to understand money but feel overwhelmed by how complicated finance seems.

moments.title: What the workshops are — simple language, games, no intimidating jargon
moments.summary: She describes the workshops as breaking investing down in simple language using interactive games and relatable analogies, in a space with no judgement, no intimidating jargon and no pretending to know things you don't.
moments.evidence: A space with no judgement, no intimidating jargon and no pretending to know things you don't.

moments.title: If you can manage a career, a family and a household, you can manage your money
moments.summary: The closing line, addressed to anyone who has felt intimidated by finance.
moments.evidence: If you're smart enough to manage a career, a family, a household, you're smart enough to manage your money too.
